name: Crustless Ham and Gruyere Quiche
ingredients: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper (to taste)
why: Egg-bound crustless quiche whose identity is the bake, not the meat. Published 444 cal / 28g protein / 3g carb sits dead-center of the band with excellent carb headroom. Ham is a distinct protein from the bacon-gruyere quiche already accepted, so not a duplicate. Ham (deli-ham), eggs, heavy cream, milk, green onions all map to the board; gruyere is the one flag. Scales cleanly to 14 servings (weigh-and-divide bake). Verified: read the recipe card nutrition directly.
